verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every pull request (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26) and offers a centralized rule system for defining engineering standards that are enforced across repositories automatically (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-38). Admins can also control which finding types run (qodo-docs-50) and generate rules from PR history (qodo-docs-13). However, nothing shows these rules are written in plain language, act as pass/fail pre-merge gates, or cover checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths'. missing for 10: explicit evidence of plain-language custom check authoring, pass/fail merge-gating status checks, examples of documentation and test-coverage checks, independent hands-on corroboration.
